name: Standard NDA Playbook
description: Firm standard for Non-Disclosure Agreements. Mutual NDA preferred.

ip_ownership.acceptable: each party retains its own pre-existing IP

standard_clauses.confidentiality: Each party agrees to maintain in strict confidence all Confidential Information received from the other party and not to disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent.
standard_clauses.governing_law: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.
